title: Inter-Warehouse Transfer
hubDescription: Track planning, picking, dispatch, transit receipt and putaway between warehouses on one document.

hub.startDescription: The request source and execution mode are independent; all four scenarios share the same domain model.
hub.executeDescription: Source picking and dispatch are tracked separately from destination receipt and putaway.

orderedErp.title: Netsis Request · Assigned
orderedErp.description: Select Netsis transfer requests, allocate open quantities and assign picking tasks to operators.

orderedStock.title: Free Stock · Assigned
orderedStock.description: Create planned picking and dispatch tasks from available stock without an ERP request.

directErp.title: Netsis Request · Direct
directErp.description: When policy allows it, start a transfer from a Netsis request without creating an operator task.

directStock.title: Free Stock · Direct
directStock.description: Start an urgent, controlled direct transfer from available stock.

source.title: Picking and Dispatch
source.description: Reservation, task acceptance, barcode picking and dispatch finalisation.

target.title: Destination Receipt and Putaway
target.description: Transit receipt, discrepancy reason, partial receipt and destination putaway.

records.title: Transfer Records
records.description: Review every variant and quantity milestone in the shared data grid.

settings.title: Transfer Process Settings
settings.description: Manage variant permissions, reservation, partial execution, transit, receipt, putaway and discrepancy policies.
